This site is the **instructor-only** home for *Statistical Inference via Data Science: A ModernDive into R and the Tidyverse* (2nd ed.). Each card below opens a complete artifact; everything except the ModernDive Labs site is generated automatically from the book's chapter content, so the resources stay in sync as the book evolves.

::: {.callout-note title="Authentication"}
This site is password-protected. The same `INSTRUCTOR_PASSWORD` unlocks every page in this hub (you'll only be prompted once per browser session). If you don't have the password, contact the authors via [moderndive.com](https://moderndive.com/about.html).
:::

## Plan the course

::: {.resource-grid}

::: {.resource-card}
### [Sample syllabus](syllabus.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

15-week US-semester plan with chapter-to-week mapping, in-class activities, and per-week homework. Includes a compressed 10-week quarter version and assessment plan (4 PS + midterm + term project).
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Lesson plans](lesson-plans.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Per-chapter teaching plan: learning objectives, section outline, Quick check counts, exercise difficulty mix, and a class-time budget (reading at 150 wpm + 3 min/QC + 2 min/LC + 3 min/section).
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Concept map](concept-map.html)
<span class="tag reference">REFERENCE</span>

Interactive vis-network dependency graph + adjacency-matrix heatmap across the 11 chapters: which chapters cite which, forward arcs vs. backward references. Useful for planning a non-linear curriculum.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Pacing calculator](pacing-calculator.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Plug in weeks-of-instruction + class-min/week + study-min/week → suggested chapter-by-week schedule. Highlights weeks that overflow the per-week budget and ranks chapters by skippability for compressed terms.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Assessment alignment matrix](assessment-matrix.html)
<span class="tag reference">REFERENCE</span>

Per-chapter table cross-referencing every Learning Objective ("In this chapter, you'll learn how to…") against the top-matching exercises. Surfaces LOs that may be under-assessed.
:::

:::

## Teach the class

::: {.resource-grid}

::: {.resource-card}
### [Slide decks](slides/index.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Eleven revealjs decks in the ModernDive hex-sticker palette. Each includes a "from last time" warm-up MCQ (Ch ≥ 2), per-section dividers, and MCQ check-ins parsed directly from the chapter's Quick checks. Tap-to-select / show-poll / show-answer interactions baked in.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Facilitator notes](facilitator-notes/index.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Per-chapter teaching scaffold: auto-extracted learning objectives + section breakdown + stuck-points parsed from each Quick check's wrong-answer options. Blank slots for cold open, cold-call moments, transition phrases, group-work prompts, exit ticket, and after-class self-check.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Misconceptions cheat-sheet](misconceptions.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Cross-chapter searchable reference: the 115 Quick check wrong-answer options distilled into "students who pick (b) are probably thinking…". Live keyword filter; perfect for pre-lecture skim or office-hours quick-lookup.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [ModernDive Labs](https://moderndive.github.io/moderndive_labs/)
<span class="tag external">EXTERNAL</span>

The companion problem-set site: ten scaffolded lab notebooks (PS1-PS10, one per chapter) plus a term-project template. Public; no password required.
:::

:::

### [Homework planner](homework-planner.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Browser-based filterable list of all 486 end-of-chapter exercises. Filter by chapter, difficulty (★/★★/★★★), group, or keyword; check boxes to assemble a set; click *Export* for a copy-pasteable list.

<span class="tag reference">REFERENCE</span>

Per-section exercise counts: which subsections have lots of practice problems, which have only one or two. Difficulty histograms per chapter.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Worked exercise solutions](solutions/index.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Complete worked solutions to every end-of-chapter exercise. Each problem expands on click; section coverage callouts at the top of each chapter.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Exam question bank](exam-bank.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Seven stratified-sample exam templates (quizzes, midterms, final, infer-unit exam) × three parallel forms each. Print-ready with workspace, point values from difficulty stars, solution links per question.
:::

::: {.resource-card}
### [Cumulative review](cumulative-review.html)
<span class="tag">CORE</span>

Three milestone study guides (after Ch 4, after Ch 7, comprehensive final) — curated medium-difficulty exercises from prior chapters + vocabulary checklist + concept-thread framing. Student-facing.
:::

:::

## About this site

::: {.callout-note title="How it builds"}
The whole hub is one Quarto project (`instructor-solutions/`) plus nine standalone HTML reports generated by R scripts in `scripts/`. The companion private repo [`moderndive_exercise_solutions`](https://github.com/moderndive/moderndive_exercise_solutions) renders this project in CI, [staticrypt](https://github.com/robinmoisson/staticrypt)s every HTML file with the shared `INSTRUCTOR_PASSWORD`, and deploys the encrypted output to its gh-pages branch (which Netlify serves at this URL).
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="To regenerate any artifact locally"}
From the book repo root:

```bash
Rscript scripts/build_syllabus.R
Rscript scripts/build_lesson_plans.R
Rscript scripts/build_homework_planner.R
Rscript scripts/build_slide_decks.R
Rscript scripts/build_facilitator_notes.R
Rscript scripts/exercise_coverage_map.R
Rscript scripts/build_concept_map.R
Rscript scripts/build_assessment_matrix.R
Rscript scripts/build_misconceptions.R
Rscript scripts/build_exam_bank.R
Rscript scripts/build_pacing_calculator.R
Rscript scripts/build_cumulative_review.R
quarto render instructor-solutions
```

All output is gitignored (`instructor-solutions/_site/`).
:::
